Payloads copied verbatim from the WhatsApp Agent Platform Developer Manual, Version 1
(originally published 2026-08-25): §GET /updates example response, §POST /messages example
response, and §5 Errors example.

Media (same manual):

- `updates_image.json`, `updates_voice.json`: §2 "Example: image message" and "Example: voice note",
  each placed verbatim in the §GET /updates example envelope (the envelope is the one in
  `updates_text.json`). Their `sha256` values don't match any bytes we have; hash tests must use
  media generated by `FakeMeta`.
- `media_get_response.json`: §4 GET /agent/v1/media/<MEDIA_ID> example response.
- `media_upload_response.json`: §4 POST /agent/v1/media response (the `<MEDIA_ID>` placeholder is verbatim).
- `media_delete_response.json`: §4 DELETE /agent/v1/media/<MEDIA_ID> response.
- `send_image_request.json`: §1 "Example request: image message" body.

The manual has no verbatim reaction example or media error bodies. Reactions are built with
`wap_helpers.reaction_message`.

`live_media_errors.json` is not from the manual: it holds the error fields (`http`, `code`, `type`,
`message`, `error_data`) recorded verbatim by the P0 live probes against the real API on 2026-09-29
(`notes/media-research/probe_results_outbound_20260929_204630.json` in the workspace), keyed
`<step>:<label>`. The probe did not record `fbtrace_id`. `FakeMeta`'s error bodies are tested against it.
